goal.title: Earn from 3 subnets simultaneously
goal.specific: Grow from a single-subnet position to three income sources so one deregistration or emission cut cannot zero the operation.
goal.achievable: Reuse existing hardware where possible; add CPU-mined subnets from the CPU Guide to avoid new GPU spend.
goal.relevant: Concentration is the top killer seen in the payout audits — top-heavy reward curves can cut a miner to zero within weeks.
